definitions.full: H5395. nasham [ נשׁם ] verb pant (Late Hebrew in nouns נִשְׁמְתָא נִשְׁמָא, ᵑ7 נְשָׁמָה, נְשִׁימָה, ; late Aramaic Ithpe`el; Syriac breathe, blow ; Arabic gently breathe (of wind), etc.; see seek a thing with labour and perseverance (Lane 3032 ); a soul , Lane ib .); — pant , of the deep and strong breathing of a woman in travail; Qal Imperfect 1singular אֶשֹּׁם Isa 42:14 . [ נִשְׁמָה ] noun feminine breath (see Biblical Hebrew, √ נשׁם ); — suffix נִשְׁמְתָח Dan 5:23 , i.e. breath of life.
